what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from India in South Africa: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1234 Indian asylum seekers in South Africa, 0.7% of all asylum seekers from India.
Refugees from India, a separate group, live mostly in Canada, the United States, Portugal and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kashmir territory in India from 1995 to 2025, and over the government of India from 1996 to 2025.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 1450 asylum seekers, and UNHCR reports no figure above zero for 2010.
The figure was at its highest, 6257, at the end of 2005.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in South Africa.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for South Africa only.
